notes.title: From Premium to Free to Play
notes.notes:
Greetings players!

We have decided to make The Balcony a free-to-play game. This change will take place on the 14th of April, 2024. 

We appreciate everyone who bought the game, thank you!

notes.title: Requesting feedback
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32248064/511b5d745211756a828b435c37ebef04607ce241.jpg[/img]
Hey,

Since our first game, The Balcony, has been on Steam for quite a while now, we are eager to hear what we did good and what could have been done better. By leaving us any kind of feedback you encourage us to provide more enjoyable gaming experiences. If we can improve on our flaws and identify our strengths, we can enhance our skills as game developers.

Despite of you having negative or positive thoughts on our game, please leave a brief review addressing the pros and cons you have in your mind. We appreciate all the input we receive.

Regards,

Holotna team

notes.title: Announcement about the release
notes.notes:
This is the moment we (and hopefully you too ːsteamhappyː) have been waiting for. '[i]The Balcony[/i]' is about to hit Steam! We have set the launch date to be on the 26th of March 2018, which means there is less than a month remaining.

We advice you to memorize that day as we will be hosting a launch sale right after the game is available here. '[i]The Balcony[/i]' will be 20% off the first week, so be sure to click the follow button on the game's store page to get a notification about the release.

Because we do not want you to leave this post empty handed, we uploaded a gameplay video of the game's zombie survival mode. Sit back, take a comfy position and enjoy!

- Miro

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D-M95VXMwGE
